detours.why: Sutherland Hall sits on the hillside above the main campus; the mapped way down is the winding footpath to the buildings below, about three times the straight line.
A road lies between them; the walk crosses at the mapped crossing to the south, and Thackeray Hall (way/154664992) has no mapped entrance, its centre snapping to the service drive behind it.

Forbes Hall's mapped path leaves south to Semple Street, and BST III (way/535446979) has no mapped entrance, its centre snapping to the service drive north of it, so the walk crosses at the mapped crossing and goes round.

The Litchfield Towers footprint (way/535897027) has no mapped entrance; its centre snaps to the plaza on its north side, and Sennott Square's centre snaps to the service drive behind it across the street to the south, so the walk goes round both.
